name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
description: Flagship welfare scheme of the Government of Maharashtra providing direct financial assistance to women aged 21 to 65 years from economically weaker households to foster financial independence and family nutrition.
department: Department of Women and Child Development, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Women permanent residents of Maharashtra aged 21 to 65 years whose family annual income does not exceed Rs. 2.5 lakh
benefits: Direct financial benefit of Rs. 1,500 per month (Rs. 18,000 per year) transferred directly into the Aadhaar-seeded DBT bank accounts of eligible women.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Maharashtra.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Department of Women and Child Development, Maharashtra

source_evidence.statement: State welfare initiative covering women across urban and rural Maharashtra.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Department of Women and Child Development, Maharashtra

source_evidence.statement: Women aged 21 to 65 residing in Maharashtra with family annual income up to Rs. 2.50 lakh holding yellow/orange ration card.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Department of Women and Child Development, Maharashtra

source_evidence.statement: Rs. 1,500 monthly DBT transfer directly to bank account of verified woman beneficiary.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Department of Women and Child Development, Maharashtra

source_evidence.statement: Official Maharashtra Ladki Bahin portal hosted at ladkibahin.maharashtra.gov.in.
November 2026 operational modalities, ongoing verification audits, and state election model code compliance guidelines pending final gazette corroboration.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Department of Women and Child Development, Maharashtra

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Provisional criteria; family income must be under Rs. 2.50 lakh and beneficiary cannot hold more than 5 acres of agricultural land.

required_documents.title: Maharashtra Domicile Certificate / 15-Year Ration Card
required_documents.description: Proof of 15 years domicile or residence in Maharashtra.

required_documents.title: Income Certificate / Yellow or Orange Ration Card
required_documents.description: Proof of family annual income up to Rs. 2.50 lakh.
required_documents.issuing_authority: Food and Civil Supplies Department / Tehsildar

required_documents.title: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Passbook
required_documents.description: Individual bank account with Aadhaar DBT enabled.
